newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN CAPTAIN HITS OUT AT SUB-STANDARD PITCH.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN CAPTAIN HITS OUT AT SUB-STANDARD PITCH.

text.p: Pakistan captain Rameez Raja criticised the Singhalese Sports Club ground authorities on Monday for preparing a sub-standard wicket for their Asia Cup game against India.
"The wicket was not for one-day cricket. You watch batsmen scoring runs and bowlers taking wickets, but not the coin deciding the fate of the game," said Rameez.
The match, called off after nine overs on Sunday because of rain and poor light, was rescheduled for Monday. But it was abandoned without a ball being bowled after heavy overnight rain.
"I have this grievance against the curator. He had about seven to eight days to prepare a wicket," Rameez said.
Pakistan were reduced to 30 for five in the short period of play on Sunday.
"Especially when you are playing a top class tournament, a crunch game between Pakistan and India, you don't come up with a sub-standard wicket," Rameez said.
Tournament officials said the teams would share the points from the match.
India, who have a low net run rate, now need to beat Bangladesh by a big margin on Thursday to ensure a place in Sunday's final against Sri Lanka.
